ios.desc:
Settle your gaming taste once and for all. Versus is a king-of-the-hill ranking app for games.

Pitting your games head-to-head and builds your personal Top 25.

No ratings. No reviews. Just pure preference.

Pick between two games at a time and Versus learns your taste. Each decision reshapes the rankings until your definitive Top 25 emerges.

It’s fast, tactile, and surprisingly addictive.

What you can do
• Battle games head-to-head
• Build your all-time Top 25
• See your podium (#1, #2, #3)
• View detailed game information
• Explore global game rankings
• Browse other players’ Top 25 lists
• Export and share your list as a clean image

No star ratings.
No reviews.
No arguing in comments.

Just decisions.

Versus is designed to feel focused, and fun — whether you’re settling a long-running debate or discovering what you truly love.

quotes.text:
I built this after seeing people on subreddits like /r/30_plus_gamers sharing images of their Top 25 games and arguing in the comments. I wanted a more playful way to do that than static lists.

Versus lets you rank games by pitting them head-to-head. Under the hood it uses a simple ELO-style system, but the goal isn’t mathematical purity, it’s to make ranking games feel like a game itself. Over time it builds your personal Top 25, which you can turn into a clean shareable image. There are also global rankings and public profiles so you can see how wildly wrong everyone else is.

It’s completely free. No ads, no paywalls, no accounts required to get started.

Mostly just sharing because I think it’s fun, and maybe a few other people here will too.
